summary: Activation validation table for the canonical Faction/Element axes. Aggregates the live roster (via /api/heroes), the boss matrix RM1.34-B, the AF2-A gift draft, and the AXIS-A plan into a single pass/fail report. The table declares `activation_ready=false` until BOTH (a) `darkness_vs_dark_unpatched` is resolved via RM1.34-B-PATCH-A and (b) `tides_orphan_unresolved` is resolved via RM1.34-B-PATCH-B. No source table is patched in this task.

validation_rows.rule: live roster element tokens MUST equal boss matrix element tokens (or alias-covered)
validation_rows.details: live uses 'dark'; matrix uses 'darkness'. Alias 'darkness->dark' is documented in AXIS-A plan and consumed only by inert resolvers. Source RM1.34-B is NOT patched.

validation_rows.rule: AF2-A gift draft element tokens MUST equal live roster
validation_rows.details: gift draft uses 'dark' aligned with live roster

validation_rows.rule: live roster faction tokens MUST equal boss matrix faction tokens (or alias-covered / design_pending)
validation_rows.details: matrix contains 'tides' faction; live roster has zero 'tides' heroes. 'tides' is flagged design_pending in AXIS-A plan but no live hero exists.
validation_rows.resolution_path: RM1.34-B-PATCH-B (either add at least one tides hero to live roster OR strike tides from matrix)

validation_rows.rule: AF2-A gift draft faction tokens MUST equal live roster
validation_rows.details: gift draft factions match live roster (12 factions, no tides minted)

validation_rows.rule: greek_borea MUST remain catalog-only / hidden from /api/heroes; legacy borea / primordial_gaia MUST 404
validation_rows.details: verified live: /api/heroes count=100, no greek_borea/borea/primordial_gaia in roster ids

validation_rows.rule: alias_map covers every mismatched token via AXIS-A inert read-through
validation_rows.details: AXIS-A plan has darkness->dark + dark->dark + shadow/oscurita alias for elements; faction aliases yokai/beasts/celtics. tides is reported design_pending, not aliased.

blockers.resolution_blocked_until: boss balance review re-ratifies the matrix under canonical token `dark`
live roster decision: mint at least one tides hero OR strike tides from matrix

recommended_patch_order: 1. RM1.34-B-PATCH-A: migrate matrix element token 'darkness'->'dark', re-run all boss matrix validators, rebaseline.
2. RM1.34-B-PATCH-B: tides decision (mint hero OR strike from matrix), re-run faction validators.
3. Re-run AXIS-A audit, AXIS-B helper audit, AXIS-C dynamic preview audit, AXIS-D table validator.
5. Only then consider any Collection/Affinity/DW runtime ON behind feature flags.
